title: Chicken Tikka
inst: Method 1 - Add ingredients to slow cooker, cook high 3-4 hours. Method 2 – Dice chicken, add to pan with ingredients. Simmer until cooked. Serve with rice and poppadom.

title: Loaded Fries
inst: Slice potato to wedges, fry light, cook 180C air fryer 20 mins. Cook bacon 15 mins, dice. Cover wedges with mayo and cheese, microwave 5 mins till melted. Top with bacon.

title: Teriyaki Salmon
inst: Boil rice and broccoli. Cook salmon, drizzle with teriyaki sauce. Serve with rice and broccoli.

title: Fish and Chips
inst: Slice potato into wedges, cook until golden. Whisk egg, roll cod in egg then breadcrumbs. Cook oven/air fryer 30 mins. Serve with wedges and mushy peas.

title: Turkey Burger
inst: Roll turkey mince into burger shape. Cook in pan, cover with cheese to melt. Place in bun with salad.

title: KFC
inst: Slice potato into wedges, cook until golden. Whisk egg, roll chicken in egg then breadcrumbs, cook 30 mins. Serve with wedges and gravy.

title: Spaghetti Bolognaise
inst: Dice onion and mushrooms, sprinkle garlic, cook soft. Add mince then tomatoes, simmer. Boil spaghetti, top with bolognaise.

title: Carbonara
inst: Boil pasta. Pan fry butter, garlic, chicken. Add diced mushrooms, bacon bits. Drain pasta, combine all ingredients and mix in Philadelphia.

title: Nacho Chicken Burger
inst: Thinly slice potato, air fry 30 mins. Crush Doritos. Roll chicken in egg white then Doritos. Air fry 30 mins. Top with cheese, serve in bun with salad.

title: Chicken Bhuna
inst: Fry onion, chilli, garlic in oil. Add spices, then diced chicken. Add tomatoes and half tin water. Bubble 20 mins. Serve on rice.

title: Chicken & Mushroom Pizza with Chips
inst: Slice potato to wedges, cook 30 mins. Cook chicken and mushrooms. Cover base with puree, cheese, chicken, mushrooms. Cook as per packet. Serve with chips.

title: Greek Flatbread
inst: Dice and grill chicken. Dice onion and tomato. Top naan with chicken, onion, tomato. Cook 10 mins. Mix grated cucumber, garlic, yoghurt. Top cooked naan with tzatziki.

title: Risotto
inst: Rehydrate mushrooms in 500ml boiling water. Cook sliced chicken, set aside. Fry butter, oil, onion, garlic. Add sliced mushrooms and rice. Gradually stir in stock for 15 mins. Add parmesan, chicken, parsley.

title: Chicken Parmesan
inst: Roll chicken in egg white then breadcrumbs. Slice potato to wedges. Air fry both 30 mins. Boil milk, stir in flour, thicken, add parmesan. Cover chicken with sauce and mature cheese. Cook further 10 mins.

title: Tandoori Fish Burger
inst: Mix fish, prawns, spices, breadcrumbs. Shape into burger. Chill 1hr. Grill 10-15 mins. Raita: mix yoghurt, mint, grated cucumber. Arrange lettuce on bun, top with burger and raita.

title: Crispy Parma Ham Gnocchi
inst: Boil gnocchi. Heat oil, fry ham crispy. Add tomatoes, garlic, basil, stir. Pour mixture over gnocchi, cover with chopped ricotta.

title: Bacon Mac n Cheese
inst: Chop bacon, cook crispy. Add spring onions, put aside. Boil macaroni. Heat oil and flour, whisk in milk until creamy. Add cheeses, mix till melted. Stir in macaroni and bacon. Top with breadcrumbs.

title: Thai Beef
inst: Boil rice. Dice onion and pepper, cook soft. Add steak, cook through. Stir in cottage cheese and curry powder. Serve on rice.

title: Pepperoni Pizza Pasta
inst: Boil spaghetti. Heat oil, crisp pepperoni. Add chopped garlic, cook 5 mins, add tomatoes and oregano. Add pasta, tear mozzarella, half lean cheese. Top with remaining lean cheese.

title: Lasagne
inst: (Ingredients mapped to 1 portion). Slice potatoes to wedges, bake 175C 30m. Cook mince brown, add tomatoes. Sauce: boil milk, stir flour, remove from heat, stir parmesan. Layer sheets, bolognaise, sauce, top with mild cheese. Cook 175C 40 mins.

title: Red Thai Curry
inst: Fry ginger/garlic paste in oil. Add curry paste, gradually pour coconut milk. Simmer, add diced chicken. Cook thoroughly, add fish sauce. Serve on rice with diced chilli.

title: Burrito
inst: Season mince with chilli, cook with onion. Place in center of wrap. Mix mayo and ketchup, pour over mince. Top with cheese and lettuce. Fold edges. Spray pan, cook burrito 5 mins each side.

title: Chicken Shawarma
inst: Marinate chicken in seasoning. Dice peppers, cook with chicken. Toast sandwich thins. Mix yoghurt and puree. Serve chicken in thins, drizzle garlic sauce.

title: Chinese Chicken Curry
inst: Dice onion and chicken, cook in pan. Mix curry powder with 100ml boiling water. Add sauce and peas to pan. Serve on rice.

title: McChicken Sandwich
inst: Mix seasoning with crushed cornflakes. Roll chicken in egg white then cornflake mix. Cook 25-30 mins at 180C. Serve in bun with lettuce and mayo.

title: Garlic Pizza Bread & Chips
inst: Dice potato for chips, cook 25-30 mins. Spread butter on each tortilla. Spread cheese mix on tortillas. Sprinkle oregano and garlic. Stack tortillas, cook 180C for 10-15 mins.

title: Prawn Linguine
inst: Boil pasta. Heat garlic 1-2 mins, stir in crème fraiche and lemon. Simmer, add prawns. Remove from heat, stir in parmesan. Combine with drained pasta.

title: Mince & Dumplings
inst: (Ingredients mapped to 1 portion). Cook mince. Mix gravy granules with boiling water, stir into mince. Add peas/carrots. Pour into dish. Mix dumpling dough with water, roll balls, add to dish. Cook 25-30 mins at 180C.

title: Jerk Chicken
ing: 0.5 pack Tilda Caribbean Rice & Peas basmati rice
inst: Marinate diced chicken overnight. Dice pepper, cook with chicken. Serve on cooked rice.

title: Toad In The Hole
inst: (Ingredients mapped to 1 portion). Heat 180C. Heat oil in dish, cook sausages 10m. Whisk egg, flour, milk for batter. Pour batter around sausages. Roast diced potato on separate tray. Cook both 25m. Serve with gravy.

title: Quesadillas
inst: Fry diced onion and garlic. Season mince with chilli, cook. Stir in tomatoes. Remove mix. Heat wrap, add half mix and cheese, fold and flip to crisp. Repeat.

title: Pepperoni Calzone
inst: Mix flour and yoghurt to dough. Roll into circle. Layer pepperoni, cheese, tomato puree on one half. Fold, press edges with fork. Create 3 slits on top. Cook 180C for 25-30 mins.

title: Hunters Chicken
inst: Dice potato. Wrap bacon around chicken. Cook 180C with chips for 25-30 mins. Pour BBQ sauce over chicken, sprinkle cheese. Cook 5-8 mins further.

title: Big Mac
inst: Mould mince into burger, cook. Cover with cheese slices. Sauce: mix mayo, ketchup, vinegar. Add burger, sauce, salad to bun. Serve with chips.

title: Beef Stroganoff
inst: Dice onion, mushrooms, cook with steak. Stir in garlic, tomato, paprika. Boil stock, add to pan with mustard. Simmer 5 mins to thicken. Stir in sour cream. Serve on boiled pasta.

title: London Pizza
inst: Slice potato to chips, fry light. Mix flour and yoghurt to dough. Roll out base. Spread puree, sprinkle cheese. Cook 180C with chips 25-30 mins. Mix garlic and mayo, spread over pizza.

title: Doner Kebab
inst: (Ingredients mapped to 1 portion). Rub seasoning into meat, mould into loaf. Cover tray with baking paper. Cook 4 hours at 100C (or quicker at higher temp). Serve in pitta with salad.

title: Meatball Marinara
inst: Season mince with paprika/garlic, roll into meatballs. Cook 180C for 20-25 mins. Heat tomato, add meatballs. Slice cheese, place on bread, melt. Top with meatballs.

title: Corned Beef Panacalty
inst: (Ingredients mapped to 1 portion). Slice potatoes thinly. Dice onion and bacon. Layer potatoes, onions, bacon, corned beef 3 times. Mix gravy, pour over. Cook 180C for 30-40 mins.

title: Popcorn Chicken
inst: Slice potato to wedges. Mix dry ingredients. Roll chicken mince into popcorn pieces. Roll in egg white then flour mix. Cook wedges and chicken 180C for 25-30 mins. Serve with gravy.

title: Sweet and Sour Chicken
inst: Mix 150ml cold water, soy sauce, vinegar, ketchup. Dice chicken and pepper, cook with garlic and chilli. Add liquid mix, stir well. Thicken until tender. Serve on rice, top with pineapple.

title: Chicken & Mushroom Pie
inst: Season chicken with garlic/salt, cook, remove. Cook mushrooms. Add mustard, boiled stock, chicken, crème fraiche. Thicken. Add mix to dish, top with pastry. Crimp sides, score top. Brush with egg white. Cook 180C 25 mins.

title: Chicken & Vegetable Soup
inst: Season chicken, cook, set aside. Dice veg, saute 2-3 mins. Add tomatoes, stock, chicken. Boil, simmer 25-30 mins. Top with parsley. Serve with warm roll.

title: Chicken & Stuffing Bun
inst: Cook chicken thoroughly. Cook stuffing according to instructions. Serve chicken and stuffing in stottie, top with gravy.

title: Nando's Halloumi Chicken
inst: Slice potato to wedges, cover in peri salt. Create 4 slits in chicken, insert halloumi. Mix sauce with honey, brush over. Air fry chicken 16-18m at 180C, chips 8-10m.

title: Chicken Thigh Gyros
inst: Marinate chicken in spices/lemon 1hr. Skewer chicken, air fry 170C 25-30m. Slice potatoes to chips, air fry 180C 12-15m. Mix garlic/yoghurt. Serve kebabs, chips, flatbread, sauce.

title: Nando's Butterfly Chicken Burger
inst: Marinate chicken. Slice potato, cover with peri salt. Air fry chips 180C 15-20m. Air fry chicken 190C 20m, adding halloumi halfway. Toast ciabatta 10m. Assemble burger.

title: Dominos BBQ Stuffed Crust
inst: Mix flour/yoghurt to dough, chill 15m. Cook chicken and peppers. Roll base. Slice baby bells, line edges, roll base over cheese. Spread BBQ sauce, top with cheese, chicken, peppers. Cook 180C 15-20m.

title: Feta & Sundried Tomato Pasta
inst: (Ingredients mapped to 1 portion). Air fry feta and tomatoes with oregano 180C 20m. Cook diced chicken, mix with feta sauce. Boil pasta, combine all.

title: Five Guys
inst: Fry burgers. Top with cheese slice to melt. Serve in bun with salad and sauce.

title: Cottage Pie
inst: (Ingredients mapped to 1 portion). Cook mince. Prepare gravy, mix with mince. Microwave mash, whisk. Layer mince, then mash in dish. Top with cheese, cook 180C 10-12m.

title: Lasagne Burrito
inst: Cook mince, mix in puree. Place mix in center of wrap. Snap lasagne sheet, place half on mince. Top with white sauce, cheddar, remaining sheet, sauce, cheddar. Fold. Air fry 180C 10m.

title: Lamb Flatbread
inst: Marinate lamb in 20g yoghurt, salt, pepper. Mix remaining yoghurt with mint and garlic. Cook lamb thoroughly. Serve on flatbread topped with sauce.

title: Stuffed Chicken Breast
inst: Mix Philadelphia with parsley. Pocket chicken breast, stuff it. Wrap chicken in Parma ham. Air fry 200C 15 mins. Air fry baby potatoes 180C 20 mins.

title: Chilli Loaded Nachos
inst: Season mince with chilli, brown. Stir in tomatoes and beans. Line tray, pour chips, top with chilli, cheese, sour cream. Cook 180C 10-12m until melted.

title: Salt & Chilli Flatbread
inst: Cook skewers and flatbread per instructions. Mix grated cucumber, garlic, yoghurt for tzatziki. Serve skewers on flatbread with salad and sauce.

title: Curried Noodles
inst: Dice chicken, cook with stir fry. Add noodles for a few mins. Mix curry powder with boiling water. Toss sauce with chicken and noodles.

title: Filled Yorkshire Pudding
inst: Cook mince. Prepare gravy and carrots, mix with mince. Cook Yorkshire per instructions. Fill with mince mix and serve.

title: Sunday Dinner
inst: Cook chicken 15-20m. Add Yorkshire last 4m. Roast potatoes/parsnips 180C 20m. Cook cabbage 8-10m. Boil carrots. Plate and top with gravy.

title: Philly Cheese Steak
inst: Fry onion soft. Cook steak brown. Add Worchester sauce. Slice bun, add steak mix, top with cheese. Air fry 2-3m to melt.
